protocol.engine_src_hash_recipe: For each file in ascending relative path order: sha256.update(UTF8(relative_posix_path) + 0 byte + raw SHA256(file_bytes)). Same recipe for each input tree.
protocol.clock: Monotonic wall time from spawning a fresh Node CLI to process exit including graph export. Report reading and hash comparison happen afterward. Independent, sequential CLI runs and new report directories. Operating-system disk cache was not flushed.
protocol.workers: Requested worker counts refer to parsing only. Inputs with fewer than 10 files are parsed on the main thread.
protocol.input_staging: Exact files copied to one stable directory per project. File lists and combined input hashes below. Compiler macros use the same macOS arm64 base as the libcurl benchmark, with project-specific flags.
protocol.summary_method: Independent medians per metric per worker configuration. Raw node/edge counts include external callees, synthetic nodes and call sites. These counts differ from the deduplicated internal function pairs in reference checks.

kilo.correctness_note: The fully matched Clang reference covers direct internal calls and function definitions only.
kilo.clang_reference_source: Fixed kilo definitions and function pairs in workstreams/yasa-c-extension/antlr-eval/fixtures/expected.json plus sameConfigNativeInternalCallSites from yasa-c-real-backend-kilo/comparison.json.

jansson.scope: Jansson 2.14 static library, 12 build-selected translation units, internal/public and generated headers
jansson.correctness_note: All 510 direct internal function pairs matched. json_error_code (jansson.h:181-183) was missing. One nested call site in dump.c has original source line 239 vs line 238 in the preprocessed Clang reference.
jansson.clang_reference_source: Existing native-direct reference from the Jansson static-library build, direct-reference.json, SHA-256 5f05696149fe41fa21bbbaff46d38f77d89213a0d803ecb20ab4d1d662538e7b

zlib.scope: zlib 1.4 zlibstatic, all 15 library translation units and top-level headers, CMake-generated zconf.h

sqlite.scope: SQLite core amalgamation and both shipped headers, default engine features

cpu_profile.sampling: Separate diagnostic CLI run, main thread only, default 5 ms interval over requested 12-22 s from startup, terminated after capturing profile. Excluded from wall times. Percentages are sample counts in this window, not estimates for the entire run.

espresso.scope: All 36 C implementation files selected by setup.py for the Espresso core, plus 7 headers. Excludes standalone CLI and CPython wrapper.

nauty.scope: Complete default nauty.a static library (15 translation units), the configure-generated native headers, all local transitive includes and the sorttemplates.c include-only fragment.
nauty.dependency_method: Clang -MM on each translation unit with the target recipe flags and shipped configure-generated nauty.h; clang -fsyntax-only passed for all 15 translation units in the staged tree.
nauty.directory_scan_note: The legacy directory scan also processes sorttemplates.c, a template included by several TUs; it is not compiled as a separate object by the project.

cpu_profile.sampling: Separate diagnostic CLI run, main thread only, default 5 ms interval over requested 12-22 s from startup, terminated after capturing profile. Excluded from wall times. Percentages are sample counts in this window, not estimates for the entire run.
